bullets: Open a new chat and have Claude already know your role, your voice and your reference files, because a Project holds them for you.
Turn the job you keep re-explaining into a Skill that Claude picks up whenever you ask for that task in plain words.
Connect Claude to the tools your work lives in, and learn enough of how it works, Claude Code included, to stop being surprised by it.
